question: Which of the following Indian pairs won the gold medal in Badminton in the Commonwealth Games - 2022 held in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty** won the **gold medal** in** Badminton** in the Commonwealth Games **- 2022** held in August 2022.
 
• Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty are a **doubles pair **who have been playing together since **2016** and have won several international tournaments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Asian badminton player **Chirag Shetty** comes from India.

 
 
• The only **men's doubles team** from India to win the** BWF World Tour 1000 series** is he and his partner Satwiksairaj Rankireddy.
 
• They are also the first Indians to win a** gold medal in badminton** at the Asian Games and to be rated inside the** top 10 of the BWF World Ranking,** with a career-high ranking of 1.
 
 
 
• **Lakshya Sen** is an Indian player in badminton.
 
 
• Sen was a member of the Indian squad that took home the **Thomas Cup in 2022.**
 
• In the 2022 Commonwealth Games, he also took home the **gold medal.**
 
 
 
• An Indian player of badminton is called **Srikanth Kidambi.**
 
 
• Kidambi, a former world champion, received the **Arjuna award in 2015** as well as the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian honor, in** 2018.**
